text: Years have passed. Me and the other children are grown adults now, all 35 years olds. We went on to live very different lives.
I became the advisor to the current chieftain, Chief Ruckers, my beloved Chief.

Though me and the others became very busy with our respective lives, we soon all reunited on this very important occasion.
Caine’s funeral.

His coffin, placed in the middle of the hall with its lid closed, rests in front of a smiling picture of him. The picture looks so small in comparison to the array of flowers surrounding it and the large closed curtain behind it.
All of us approach the coffin one by one, placing our flowers on the coffin. My turn soon approaches and as I go to place my flower in respect to Caine, someone who was often there for me growing up…
I suddenly slip and fall on the floor.
This is so embarrassing! I immediately look around the room.
Thank Mamu that the chief didn’t attend the funeral, how could I face him if he saw such an embarrassing display from me.
Ugh! But even though the chief isn’t here to see me fall, everyone else probably did! What do I do?

options.label: 1: Go around the room and try to save whatever is left of your reputation
2: Pretend that it never happened and go talk to the others

text: I can’t let this damage my reputation! I have to fix this at all cost! I make my way to the closest person to me.
Fursttryl: “Man…these floors…they surely need to get fixed am i right? I mean…that fall of mine earlier wasn’t my fault. It was the floors!”
The lady I have approached looks at me with a somewhat uncomfortable expression on her face.
Mourning Lady: “Yeah…um…we’re kind of in the middle of something right now…”
Fursttryl: “Oh right! Um…yes! I’ll leave you that!”
Great…I think I just made things even worse…dammit…well I should probably just cut my losses and go speak with the others while I’m here.
Everyone is probably too distracted by the funeral to care about me falling anyways. I’m overthinking it. I should go speak with everyone else while I’m here

Fursttryl: “Caine, I’m so sorry for acting so improper at your funeral. It was not my intention to bring such shame during your memorial. Let this not be a reflection of how I feel towards you and I hope your spirit finds rest.”
I take a bow before his coffin. Showing my remorse and my respect. After doing so, I believe now I can continue my time at this gathering in peace.
I should go and speak with everyone else while I’m here.
